title: Native Variable declarations and retained OVAL transformations
description: Declare typed local or constant Variables from literal data, other Variables, collected Object fields, or explicit recursive transformations. Active 0.4 forms preserve source operand order, collection multiplicity, empty values, and evaluation status; datatype compatibility and status propagation are checked separately by semantic validation or a qualified runtime.

concat.title: Concatenated components
concat.description: Concatenate two or more components in order. Multiple values produce the Cartesian product of component values. Components follow inherited source casting rules when a string conversion is required; incompatible values produce an error. A missing or nonexistent component yields the inherited source status; Error, Incomplete, Not Collected, and Not Applicable statuses are not silently converted to strings.

x-doc-review.note: Existing native annotations state component order and Cartesian combinations. Casting, output representation and no-value/error-status mappings remain pending semantic review; examples demonstrate syntax only, not executed results.

oneOf.title: Concatenation expression
oneOf.description: Join two or more ordered expressions while retaining collection/status semantics.

pattern.title: Capture pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression containing the capture group to return.

value.title: Input expression
value.description: Expression producing the string value(s) to search. Each value is processed independently.

regex_capture.title: Regular-expression capture
regex_capture.description: Capture text from each input string using the first capturing group. The source regex dialect and first-match behavior are retained; inputs with no capture group or no match produce an empty string under the inherited function contract.

x-doc-review.note: The current native annotation specifies the first group but delegates regex dialect, no-match/no-group behavior and statuses to inherited rules. The pattern member is only a string constraint; validating it does not prove capture semantics.

oneOf.title: Regex capture expression
oneOf.description: Extract the first capture from each input string.

unique.title: Unique values or ordered populations
unique.description: Remove duplicate scalar values from one expression or from multiple ordered component populations. Multiple components are flattened in source order before first-occurrence deduplication; duplicates and diagnostic statuses are preserved. Record data is not a supported transformation operand.

x-doc-review.note: The native description excludes record operands, although the expression reference does not by itself close every operand type. Equality, ordering and unavailable-value propagation remain pending; no deduplication runtime is executed.

count.title: Counted values
count.description: Evaluate the nested expression and return the number of values it produces as one integer. Count each produced value, including duplicates; do not count unique values unless the author explicitly wraps the input with unique. An empty, successfully evaluated collection produces zero. Missing, incomplete, not-collected, error, and other non-success states must retain the native status contract instead of silently becoming zero. Runtime equivalence is subject to independent conformance tests.

oneOf.title: Count expression
oneOf.description: Return the cardinality of values from a nested Variable expression as one integer. Duplicates contribute to the count; non-success statuses are not coerced to zero.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Literal delimiter; an empty delimiter is literal, not a regular expression.

value.title: Input expression

split.title: Split values
split.description: Split each input string on the explicit literal delimiter. Preserve leading, trailing, and adjacent empty parts, duplicates, collection order, and diagnostic statuses.

oneOf.title: Split values expression
oneOf.description: Split each input string on the explicit literal delimiter. Preserve leading, trailing, and adjacent empty parts, duplicates, collection order, and diagnostic statuses.

substring_start.title: Start

substring_length.title: Length

value.title: Input expression
value.description: Expression producing string values to slice independently.

substring.title: Substring values
substring.description: Extract a substring from each input string using explicit signed 32-bit source options. Out-of-range and diagnostic outcomes remain errors/statuses; no defaults are inferred.

oneOf.title: Substring values expression
oneOf.description: Extract a substring from each input string using explicit signed 32-bit source options. Out-of-range and diagnostic outcomes remain errors/statuses; no defaults are inferred.

values.title: Numeric operands

arithmetic.title: Arithmetic values
arithmetic.description: Add or multiply two or more numeric populations over the source Cartesian product. Integer-only inputs produce integers; any float input produces floats. Invalid types and diagnostic populations are not coerced.

oneOf.title: Arithmetic values expression
oneOf.description: Add or multiply two or more numeric populations over the source Cartesian product. Integer-only inputs produce integers; any float input produces floats. Invalid types and diagnostic populations are not coerced.

sort.description: `document` preserves input order; `lexical`, `numeric`, and `natural` select the corresponding explicit ordering.

values.title: Values expression or ordered populations
values.description: Expression or ordered component populations to join. Multiple populations are flattened in source order; values, duplicates, and diagnostic statuses are preserved.

merge.title: Merged values
merge.description: Combine one or more ordered input populations into one string using an explicit delimiter, sort mode, and order. document preserves flattened input order; other modes sort before joining. Duplicates are preserved unless a separate unique expression removes them.
